canonical_plan.coordinate_system: mm; right-handed; x/y floor plane, z up; local origin; glTF adapter converts units and up-axis

goals: Simulated measured survey; furniture concept only

evidence.caption: Authored simulated room/door survey, not a real customer photo or measured national reference

notes.original: Both surveyed floor room layouts are supplied separately. Stairwell dimensions and inter-floor passage are NOT validated; reserve designer review, do not infer a staircase from a photo.
notes.turkish_translation: Her iki katın oda krokisi ayrı verildi; merdiven bağlantısı doğrulanmadı.

issues.message: Designer must verify survey, services, stairs, safety, installation and final project. Synthetic furniture screening is not construction approval.
